name: Modella Woollens Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1961, Modella Woollens Ltd. is engaged in the business of trading in synthetic suiting and furnishing/plastic materials.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company manufactures shoddy yarn which is mainly used for manufacture of woolen fabrics. Company also manufactures and dyes woolen and synthetic tops, and undertakes commission combing, both of wool and other synthetic fibers. Company is also in the construction business.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
